row.evidence: Talkdesk's developer docs say it "enables automatic and simplified user management through the SCIM 2.0 protocol", but the pricing and plan-comparison pages do not name SSO or SCIM on any plan.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. SCIM 2.0 (Users only) is documented with Okta, Entra ID and OneLogin generic SCIM apps plus custom clients, but no Talkdesk page says which edition includes it, so status is unknown under rule 1a. Pricing page lists per-user monthly prices without stating billing term (Digital Essentials $85, Voice Essentials $105, Elite $165, Industry Experience Clouds $225); recorded as shown. API access (pricing cards list 'API Access' on Essentials) is granted on request via support.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: 'Everything in essentials, plus' per the pricing card.

auth.token_source: OAuth client credentials (Basic auth with client ID/secret) to https://<account-name>.talkdeskid.com/oauth/token with scope=scim and token_type=opaque, producing an STS token used as the IdP bearer/secret token
auth.token_expiry: Set by expires_in (example 31556952 s, about one year); STS tokens can live forever as long as they are being used

endpoints.notes: GET /scim/v2/Groups is documented (read/query only), but the SCIM API overview says only the User resource is supported.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated agents keep call history and settings; new activity is not routed to them. SCIM DELETE removes the user from the account.
deprovision.notes: Okta guide enables 'Deactivate Users'; licence release comes from the help-centre agent deactivation article (legacy UI).

custom.how: Talkdesk extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:talkdesk:2.0:User with rolesString (role name) and teamsString (team name); values must already exist in Talkdesk

roles.how: rolesString attribute in the Talkdesk SCIM extension; default role Agent if not mapped

rate_limits.text: 4 requests per second; 429 on excess, retry within the next second

limitations.text: Only the User resource is supported; Entra group provisioning must be disabled.
SCIM does not work for Talkdesk Phone user creation.
Provisioned users consume a licence immediately; users may be created Deactivated if licences run out.

Okta, Entra and OneLogin setups use generic SCIM apps (Okta '(OAuth Bearer Token) Governance with SCIM 2.0', Entra non-gallery app, OneLogin 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)'), not a Talkdesk catalogue app.

capabilities.notes: Non-SCIM Users API is read-only; user writes go through the SCIM API.

endpoints.purpose: Create an Audit Logs report job (Explore API)

limitations.text: API access is granted on request to customers (submit a support request); APIs are described as available to platform partners and enterprise customers.

okta.notes: OIN Talkdesk app ticks SAML only; Talkdesk's own guide provisions through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 app (c16).

entra.notes: No Talkdesk tutorial in the Entra saas-apps TOC; Talkdesk documents a non-gallery SCIM app (c21).

onelogin.notes: Via OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app.

fallbacks.other_sync: Talkdesk for Salesforce: users added in Salesforce are added to Talkdesk automatically.
